milk.source: REFERENCE ONLY — FSSAI Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 2.1.2; Chapter 2.1 dairy compendium reviewed 03-Nov-2026. Reference minima for raw cow milk: fat 3.2% m/m and SNF 8.3% m/m; raw buffalo milk: fat 5.0% m/m and SNF 9.0% m/m. Compendium is not itself the legal instrument; verify current Gazette notifications, product definition, point of sale, method and amendments before activation. Independent regulatory review pending.

milk.safety_policy: Safety and adulteration screening outcomes must be assessed separately and must not be averaged into a composition grade. A screening result is not a substitute for confirmatory laboratory testing.
